title.narrative: Recuperação produtiva sustentável para paisagens resilientes, estado do Acre, Amazonia (IPAM)

description.narrative: IPAM has a lot experience in improving the income of family farmers. In Acre, they have worked with family farmers and cooperatives and there is interest from the State government to work with IPAM. The project with IPAM aim at on strengthening family farms with a focus on the recuperation of degraded areas ¿ and with the idea to get to scale via cooperatives and/or producer organisations.
